subject: Post-call: Acme pilot acceptance checklist & ownership roster
summary: Post-discovery recap capturing acceptance criteria for a 3-week pilot, high-level timeline, and a RACI-style owner roster for infra, app, security, and procurement.
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@acmehealth.ai>
Cc: soojin_lee <soojin@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T15:04:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call: Acme pilot acceptance checklist & ownership roster

Hi Olivia — great conversation today. Per our call, I wanted to capture the agreed pilot scope and the proposed owners so we have a single reference. I attached a simple checklist (acme_pilot_acceptance_checklist.xlsx) and a network diagram for your infra team.

High-level summary: 3-week pilot, Redwood-hosted model (dedicated pool), validation against three success criteria below. We expect an infra smoke test (1 day), functional verification (5 days), and evaluation run (10 business days).

Acceptance criteria (proposed):
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency under 400ms for 512-token sequences on the test harness.
- Quality: Human-rated pass rate >= 85% on the provided sample prompts (scoring rubric in tab 2 of the spreadsheet).
- Data handling: All logs and traces retained per your retention policy (legal), and no customer PII persists beyond session per configuration.

Proposed RACI / owners (first pass):
- Infra (network, VPN, VPC peering, firewall rules): Responsible = John Park (Acme), Accountable = dev_patel (Redwood Solutions), Consulted = soojin_lee (security)
- App (integration, SDKs, request routing): Responsible = hannah_schmitt (Redwood CS), Accountable = John Park (Acme), Consulted = connor_obrien (sales)
- Security & compliance (SAML, logs, attestations): Responsible = soojin_lee (Redwood), Accountable = John Park (Acme Sec), Consulted = neha_kapoor (procurement)
- Procurement / PO (billing setup, contract signature): Responsible = neha_kapoor (Redwood sales ops), Accountable = Olivia Grant (Acme procurement)

Key next steps (owner, date):
- Acme infra kick-off + share CIDR and firewall rules (John) — by 2026-11-27
- Redwood to provision dedicated trial pool and provide onboarding keys (dev_patel) — by 2026-11-29
- Security questionnaire & required artifacts (soojin_lee -> Olivia) — deliver by 2026-11-28
- Sign SOW + PO (legal/procurement) — target 2026-12-02

Please confirm owners above or propose changes. If you want, I can convert the checklist into a mutual action plan in HubSpot (I added HS-24892).

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.com
(Attachment: acme_pilot_acceptance_checklist.xlsx, network-requirements-diagram.png)

From: Olivia Grant <olivia@acmehealth.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: John Park <john.park@acmehealth.ai>
Date: 2026-11-26T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Acme pilot acceptance checklist & ownership roster

Connor — thanks for the clear recap and checklist. This matches our expectations. A few quick notes from our side: we can commit to the 3-week cadence, however procurement needs a PO by 2026-12-01 to get finance approval for the month. John will own infra tasks and I will keep procurement engaged.

A couple of minor edits to acceptance criteria:
- Latency: can we make the 95th percentile target 450ms (non-blocking) as our internal load varies?
- Quality: we will run the sample prompts across 3 teams; pass threshold okay at 82% if the qualitative feedback is all green.

John and I will share the CIDR + VPN secret via our secure file transfer by EOD 11/27. For security artifacts, we need a stamped SOC-2 scoping note and your data flow diagram for our compliance review.

Olivia
Head of Product, Acme Health
(Attachment: acme_po_requirements.pdf)

From: soojin_lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev@redwood.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-27T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Acme pilot acceptance checklist & ownership roster

Quick heads-up from security: I'll own the SOC-2 scoping note and the redwood data-flow diagram. Dev, please bundle the runtime logs export guide and the KV cache retention docs. We should expect a short review cycle (48-72 hrs) after we hand over artifacts.

I'll also create a lightweight checklist for the compliance reviewers so Acme can trace each artifact to a requirement (will attach to the Drive link).

Sooj
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: redwood_soc2_scoping_template.docx)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@acmehealth.ai>
Cc: John Park <john.park@acmehealth.ai>, soojin_lee <soojin@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Acme pilot acceptance checklist & ownership roster

Thanks everyone — updating checklist per Olivia's notes (latency 450ms / quality 82%) and attaching SOW draft. Next actions:
- John: share CIDR + VPN by EOD 11/27 (if delayed, notify dev_patel)
- dev_patel: provision trial pool + onboarding keys by 11/29 (confirm when done)
- soojin_lee: upload SOC-2 scoping note + data flow by 11/28 (link: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/AcmePilot/AcceptanceChecklist)
- neha_kapoor: start PO intake, please provide estimated billing run and invoice contact for Acme
- hannah_schmitt: schedule a 60-minute technical onboarding demo with Acme application owners for 2026-12-03

I'll convert the spreadsheet into a mutual action plan in HubSpot (HS-24892) and share driver-level calendar invites for the onboarding demo. If all artifacts land on time we can start the functional verification window on 2026-12-01 and complete the pilot evaluation by 2026-12-15 per the adjusted acceptance targets.

Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(Attachments: redwood-pilot-sow-v1.pdf)
